text: Program Description The major is designed to train professionals with expertise in access, transmission, processing and utilization of information, who are capable of research, design, manufacturing and engineering integration in the branches of the state economy as well as the national defense. This major is a broad-range field. Strongly advantaged in information network engineering design, integration, supervision, management and testing, it is featured with information engineering design, integration, management and operation, in good cooperation with many IT engineering design, integration, construction and operation of enterprises.
